Mina: Night shift check-in: spun up 8 x p4d in us-west2 to cover API surge. Queue depth dropped but still seeing short spikes (~3s tail latency). Noticed 2 spot evictions around 02:14 UTC.
Sam: Thanks Mina. Which AZs did you spread across? any single-AZ pressure? :thinking_face:
Mina: Spread across us-west2-a/b/c. Evictions came from -b twice. Overall headroom per-AZ: a=18%, b=4%, c=22% (roughly, after the spinup).
Sam: @Lee can we confirm quota in us-west2-b? might need emergency bump or shift some jobs to c.
Lee: ops-bot already dropped an eviction alert at 02:14. I just pulled quota: us-west2-b GPU quota is 120 reserved, we're at 116 allocated. We have ~1 full node (4 GPUs) cushion but not much.
ops-bot: [ALERT] spot-eviction detected on instance id i-0f9c... in us-west2-b at 2026-03-17T02:14:05Z. Auto-fallback engaged: reroute to us-west2-c for in-flight requests.
Tara: If fallback is enabled that's good. Mina, did any user-facing requests fail or hit graceful-degradation? any 5xxs?
Mina: No 5xxs. A few user requests hit longer tail due to cache refills (KV miss) but our canary model fallback kept outputs within SLOs. One route saw +8% p99 latency for 3m.
Sam: Can we temporarily reduce batch size for critical routes in us-west2-b while Lee looks at quota? small config change but might reduce eviction bursts.
Mina: I'll patch route config. Proposed change:
```
routes.critical.batch.max_tokens: 512 -> 384
routes.critical.batch.max_batch: 64 -> 48
```
Mina: Will monitor next 20m and report back.
Lee: I'll open a support ticket with cloud provider requesting a soft quota bump for us-west2-b (+12 GPUs) and enable a temporary regional fallback policy. Ticket #INF-824 opened.
Sam: Also suggest enabling staggered prewarm in -b to reduce concurrent spot allocations during maintenance windows. @Mina can you add a quick note to the prewarm script?
Mina: Yup. Adding a 30s jitter to the prewarm lambda and lowering parallelism from 6->4 for -b only.
Tara: Nice. If things stabilize, let's keep the bump as emergency-only and revisit autoscaler thresholds in next retro. No blocker for me.
Mina: Update: 10m after config change, p99 tail in -b dropped from +8% to +3%. Queue depth stable. Will follow up in 30m.
Sam: Thanks everyone. If anything degrades, ping #eng-oncall. Otherwise we'll sync in the AM handoff.
ops-bot: [INFO] ticket INF-824 created by Lee. Link: https://support.cloud.example/cases/INF-824
Mina: End of thread — leaving metrics watch on. :eyes:
